name: writing-honest-claims
title_zh: 结论写到证据撑得住的那一级就停笔
tagline_zh: 跑完分析最怕把相关性写成因果。它按观察、方向、决策支持三级给你选措辞，没有实验设计就绝不让你说「导致」。
tagline_en: After analysis, the temptation is to write correlation as causation. It offers three claim tiers — observed.
desc_en: Writes findings in language the evidence can carry — the claim ladder (observed → directional → decision-support, never causal without a design), effect sizes over drama, banned phrasings. Use when writing any conclusion, report section, playbook, or public page from analysis results.
why_zh: 它不润色，只做减法：把每个结论钉回它实际能站的那一级，并给出被禁措辞的替换清单。
why_en: It doesn't polish, it subtracts: pins each conclusion to the tier it can actually stand on, with a swap list for banned phrasings.
limit_zh: 只管措辞分级，不替你补统计检验、置信区间或样本量；没有随机化或对照设计时，它一律压到「观察/方向」级。
limit_en: Only grades wording; it won't add tests, CIs, or sample sizes. Without randomization or a control design it caps everything at observed/directional.
title_en: Stop your claims where the evidence runs out
